spec.moment: The waiters bring out a tiramisu with a sparkler and sing to Priya on the string-lit patio.

elements.name: tiramisu with a sparkler
elements.look: a small square tiramisu dusted with cocoa on a white plate, a bright sparkler fizzing gold sparks from its top

elements.name: long table
elements.look: one long wooden table crowded with pasta bowls, red wine glasses and crumpled napkins

elements.name: string lights
elements.look: warm glowing bulbs strung in loose loops overhead across the patio

elements.name: Priya
elements.look: a small figure in a yellow dress leaning toward the sparkler, hands near her cheeks

elements.name: the friends
elements.look: two small simple figures in a blue shirt and a green sweater, seated at the table

elements.name: guitar on the pier
elements.look: a small wooden guitar resting on a plank pier at the back edge

spec.scene: A small stone patio patch with a wooden patio edge at the back, warm string lights looping overhead. In the center a long table holds pasta bowls and red wine glasses, and a tiramisu with a fizzing gold sparkler sits before a small figure in a yellow dress; two friends in blue and green sit beside her. A waiter in a white apron stands at the left. At the back edge, a sliver of wooden pier with a small guitar leans against a post, lit gold by the lamps.
spec.title: A Sparkler for Priya
spec.caption: Tiramisu, a sparkler, and all eight of us singing off-key for Priya.
